com.sun.tools.javadoc

类 AnnotationTypeDocImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.javadoc.DocImpl
      • com.sun.tools.javadoc.ProgramElementDocImpl
        • com.sun.tools.javadoc.ClassDocImpl
          • com.sun.tools.javadoc.AnnotationTypeDocImpl
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    AnnotationTypeDoc, ClassDoc, Doc, ProgramElementDoc, Type, Comparable<Object>

    public class AnnotationTypeDocImpl
extends ClassDocImpl
implements AnnotationTypeDoc
    Represents an annotation type.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

    从以下版本开始:
    1.5
    作者:
    Scott Seligman

      • elements

        public AnnotationTypeElementDoc[] elements()
        Returns the elements of this annotation type. Returns an empty array if there are none. Elements are always public, so no need to filter them.
        指定者:
        elements 在接口中 AnnotationTypeDoc
        返回:
        the elements of this annotation type.
